title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 application uses ADO with likely string concatenation for SQL queries, creating critical security exposure
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security breach in production banking system with potential data theft and regulatory violations
suggested_approach: Replace all ADO Recordset operations with Entity Framework parameterized queries, implement repository pattern with proper input validation
success_criteria: Zero string concatenation in SQL queries
All database operations use parameterized queries
Security audit passes with no SQL injection findings

provenance.evidence: Reference to Microsoft ActiveX Data Objects 2.0 Library indicates direct SQL execution patterns

title: Modernize Authentication System
problem_statement: Custom VB6 login form lacks modern security standards like multi-factor authentication, secure session management, and password policies
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to banking system, compliance violations, weak credential management
suggested_approach: Implement ASP.NET Core Identity with JWT tokens, integrate with enterprise SSO, add MFA support
success_criteria: Secure session management with proper timeout

title: Replace COM Components with .NET Equivalents
problem_statement: Multiple ActiveX controls and COM components create deployment complexity and compatibility issues in modern environments
risk_if_unaddressed: Deployment failures, compatibility issues, inability to run on modern operating systems
suggested_approach: Map each COM control to equivalent ASP.NET Core/Blazor components, implement custom controls where necessary
success_criteria: Zero COM dependencies in modernized application
All UI functionality preserved with .NET equivalents

title: Complete VB6 Source Code Analysis
problem_statement: Current repository contains only partial VB6 source code, preventing comprehensive modernization planning
risk_if_unaddressed: Incomplete modernization with missing functionality, unexpected runtime failures
dependencies: Access to complete VB6 source repository
suggested_approach: Obtain complete VB6 source code, run comprehensive static analysis, document all dependencies and business rules

provenance.evidence: Truncated form file indicates incomplete source code availability
